summary.headline: Astrological Rules for Nourishment
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging nourishment in a nativity, progressing from triplicity lords of the Sun or Moon to the part of fortune, conjunction or prevention, Jupiter or Venus, and finally the Moon, with attention to malefic impediments, angles, succedents, the ascendant, and midheaven.
